general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Lecture, Coaching, Roleplay, Active learning, In-class lecture, Discussion, Group work,Test
general_information.Time Allocation: Learning hours (150h) 45 hours of classes (60 sessions) + 105 hours of self-study
general_information.Description: I. Course Implementation Orientation Requirements（科目の実施オリエンテーションの用件）: Study the basic knowledge of Japanese phonetics and vocabulary to improve Japanese language proficiency. Build a foundation useful for future self-study and research activities. II. Course Objectives（主題の目的）: Phonetics: Learn basic knowledge about Japanese phonetics and aim to achieve natural pronunciation. In particular, through repeated practice of rhythm, accent, and prosody, aim to be able to check on your own whether you are pronouncing correctly. Vocabulary: Learn the basic knowledge of lexical theory while refining lexical sensitivity and enriching vocabulary. Through data analysis, develop the ability to objectively analyze how words are chosen depending on the situation and interlocutor.
general_information.StudentTasks: ・Attendance rate of 80% or higher. ・Conduct research and discussions on issues taken up by the group. ・Present the results of the research. ・Review lectures.
general_information.Tools: ・Use Japanese textbooks. ・Use ppt for lectures and student presentations. ・Since online resources will be used, each student needs to bring their own PC to class.

description: I. Course Implementation Orientation Requirements（科目の実施オリエンテーションの用件）: Study the basic knowledge of Japanese phonetics and vocabulary to improve Japanese language proficiency. Build a foundation useful for future self-study and research activities. II. Course Objectives（主題の目的）: Phonetics: Learn basic knowledge about Japanese phonetics and aim to achieve natural pronunciation. In particular, through repeated practice of rhythm, accent, and prosody, aim to be able to check on your own whether you are pronouncing correctly. Vocabulary: Learn the basic knowledge of lexical theory while refining lexical sensitivity and enriching vocabulary. Through data analysis, develop the ability to objectively analyze how words are chosen depending on the situation and interlocutor.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Acquire basic knowledge of Japanese phonetics.
Learn and practice how to write reports and make presentations in Japanese.
Understand the features of Japanese word pronunciation (mora, foot, accent) and the rules of compound word accent, and improve pronunciation.
Understand the pronunciation of Japanese sentences and improve pronunciation.
Understand mother tongue interference and improve pronunciation.
Understand methods for improving pronunciation and apply them to self-study.
Acquire basic knowledge of Japanese vocabulary.
Acquire basic knowledge of Japanese orthography.
Refine lexical sensitivity and enrich vocabulary.
Learn and practice methods of data collection and analysis.
